items_flat.title_en: Subscribers sue Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google over alleged AI-slowdown pact
items_flat.title_zh: 訂戶控告 Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceXAI 與 Google 涉嫌協議放慢 AI
items_flat.summary_en: Four paid subscribers to ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Gemini filed a proposed class action in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, alleging the labs violated the Sherman Act by agreeing to slow frontier progress after Dario Amodei’s Sept. 12 essay. The complaint says Sam Altman, Elon Musk and Demis Hassabis publicly endorsed that direction the same day, and that slower capability growth reduces the value of paid subscriptions.
items_flat.summary_zh: 四名 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、Gemini 付費訂戶向加州北區聯邦法院提起擬集體訴訟，指各實驗室在 Amodei 9/12 專文後公開附和「放慢前線」，構成《休曼法》違法協議，並使付費訂閱價值下降。
items_flat.analysis_en: The filing treats public safety coordination as price-and-quality collusion. That is a novel antitrust theory; it does not prove a private agreement existed, and the labs have not answered in court. What it does change immediately is the legal risk of joint pacing language.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 起訴把公開安全協調當成品質與價格共謀，理論新穎，尚未證明存在私下協議，各實驗室也尚未應訴。立刻改變的是聯合「放慢」表述的法律風險。
items_flat.quote: The antitrust laws do not permit competitors to decide among themselves that competition is too dangerous.
items_flat.quote_zh: 反托拉斯法不容許競爭者自行認定競爭過於危險。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic and Accenture each pledge $1B for embedded frontier evaluation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 與 Accenture 各承諾 10 億美元做嵌入式前線評估
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced a partnership with Accenture, led by Faculty, to evaluate and red-team its frontier models, run alignment assessments, and test safeguards. Each company expects to invest at least $1 billion over five years so independent evaluators work inside Anthropic with employee-like access.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布與 Accenture（由 Faculty 主導）合作，對前線模型進行評估、紅隊、對齊與防護測試。雙方預計五年各投入至少 10 億美元，讓獨立評估者進入公司、取得接近員工的權限。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the most concrete follow-through yet of Amodei’s “pace the frontier” call: money and an inside seat, not another external audit PDF. The open question is independence—whether Faculty-led work can report against its host.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Amodei「放慢前線」呼籲迄今最具體的落地：真金白銀與內部席位，而非再一份外部審計 PDF。不確定的是獨立性——Faculty 能否對東道主提出不利報告。
items_flat.quote: From this vantage point, embedded evaluators can assess how a company operates, verify that it is keeping its safety commitments, and identify blind spots.
items_flat.quote_zh: 從這個位置，嵌入式評估者可以檢視公司如何運作、核實是否履行安全承諾，並找出盲點。

items_flat.title_en: Plugin4Shell: zero-click RCE across Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI
items_flat.title_zh: Plugin4Shell：Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、Gemini CLI 零點擊遠端執行
items_flat.summary_en: AIR Security disclosed Plugin4Shell, a SHA-pinning bypass that can make coding agents install attacker-controlled plugin code while appearing to honor a reviewed commit. Anthropic patched Claude Code in 2.1.179 and OpenAI patched Codex; remaining Copilot and Gemini CLI exposure was still being retired.
items_flat.summary_zh: AIR Security 揭露 Plugin4Shell，可繞過 SHA pinning，讓編程代理在看似遵守已審核提交的情況下安裝攻擊者外掛。Anthropic 已於 Claude Code 2.1.179 修補，OpenAI 已修 Codex；Copilot 與 Gemini CLI 剩餘安裝仍待清退。
items_flat.analysis_en: The story is the plugin marketplace layer, not a model jailbreak. Pinning was the control enterprises trusted; until Copilot is patched and remaining Gemini CLI installs are retired, the blast radius stays agent-wide.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 重點在外掛市集層，不是模型越獄。企業信任的控制是 pinning；在 Copilot 修補、Gemini CLI 舊安裝清退前，影響面仍是整條代理鏈。

items_flat.title_en: Reuters: Anthropic weighs a new model before IPO to answer GPT-6 Astra
items_flat.title_zh: 路透：Anthropic 考慮在 IPO 前推新模型以回應 GPT-6 Astra
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters, citing three sources, reported Anthropic is considering releasing a new model to counter OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra traction ahead of an expected IPO. Sources said Astra accounts for about 13% of enterprise AI spend tracked by Ramp versus about 8% for Claude Fable, and that OpenAI recently overtook Anthropic on OpenRouter developer spend.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透引述三名消息人士稱，Anthropic 正考慮在預期 IPO 前發布新模型，以回應 GPT-6 Astra 的企業採用。Ramp 追蹤的企業 AI 支出中 Astra 約 13%、Claude Fable 約 8%；OpenRouter 開發者支出上 OpenAI 近期超越 Anthropic。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is competitive pressure, not a ship date. It sits uneasily next to Amodei’s public slowdown argument: any pre-IPO launch would have to be justified as a safety-cleared product, not just a market reply.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是競爭壓力，不是發布日。它與 Amodei 公開的放慢論並存：若 IPO 前推出，必須以通過安全審查的產品自居，而不能只是市場回應。
items_flat.quote: Anthropic is considering rolling out a new AI model to counter OpenAI’s momentum since its launch of GPT-6 Astra, according to three sources.
items_flat.quote_zh: 據三名消息人士，Anthropic 正考慮推出新模型，以回應 OpenAI 自 GPT-6 Astra 發布後的動能。

items_flat.title_en: The Verge profiles METR, Redwood, and Apollo as labs’ default independent auditors
items_flat.title_zh: The Verge 專文：METR、Redwood、Apollo 成為實驗室默認獨立審計方
items_flat.summary_en: The Verge published a reported profile of METR, Redwood Research, and Apollo Research, arguing recent OpenAI and Anthropic misalignment incidents have pushed the three nonprofits into the role of go-to independent auditors.
items_flat.summary_zh: The Verge 刊出 METR、Redwood Research、Apollo Research 報導專文，認為近期 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的未對齊事件，已把這三家非營利組織推成前線實驗室的默認獨立審計方。
items_flat.analysis_en: The auditors are now part of the product story, not a side beat. What remains unsettled is whether “embedded” access will be standardized—or stay a negotiated, lab-by-lab privilege.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 審計方已進入產品敘事，不再是邊角新聞。尚未確定的是「嵌入式」權限會否標準化，或仍是逐家談判的特權。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes an Australian Youth Safety Blueprint
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 發布澳洲青少年安全藍圖
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published an Australian Youth Safety Blueprint describing six pillars for teen AI use, including literacy, age-appropriate safeguards, privacy-protective age assurance, crisis-support links, and parental controls. It said ChatGPT for teens in Australia will follow those defaults.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布澳洲青少年安全藍圖，提出素養、適齡防護、保護隱私的年齡確認、危機支援連結與家長控制等六支柱，並表示澳洲青少年版 ChatGPT 將採這些預設。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is policy positioning in a jurisdiction that has already forced age rules on platforms. It is a framework and a product default, not new model capability; enforcement details still sit with Australian regulators.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是在已對平台強制年齡規則的司法管轄區做政策卡位。它是框架與產品預設，不是新模型能力；執行細節仍在澳洲監管端。
items_flat.quote: We are introducing the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint, a roadmap for protecting young people as they use AI and a practical contribution to the Australian policy landscape.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出《澳洲青少年安全藍圖》，作為保護年輕人使用 AI 的路線圖，並對澳洲政策討論提出實務貢獻。

items_flat.title_en: xAI releases Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 at unchanged price
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 發布 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0，售價不變
items_flat.summary_en: xAI released Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0, a speech-to-text model it says is twice as accurate as 1.0 on its real-world tests and ranks first among 32 streaming models on an Artificial Analysis public leaderboard. Features include timestamps, diarization, multichannel support and smarter turn detection; 1.0 is slated for deprecation once 2.0 becomes the Speech-to-Text API default.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 發布語音轉文字模型 Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0，稱實測準確度為 1.0 的兩倍，並在 Artificial Analysis 32 個串流模型榜上居首。功能含時間戳、說話人分離、多聲道與更聰明的輪次偵測；待 2.0 成為 API 預設後，1.0 將停用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a speech stack upgrade, not the delayed Grok 4.7/4.8 frontier text models. Same price plus a claimed accuracy jump is the commercial pitch; independent replication of the leaderboard claim is still the test.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是語音棧升級，不是延期的 Grok 4.7/4.8 前線文字模型。同價加宣稱準確度翻倍是商業賣點；榜單數字仍待獨立複現。
items_flat.quote: Across our real-world evaluations, Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 is one of the most accurate transcription models available today and twice as accurate as Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0, at the same price.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在我們的真實場景評估中，Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 是當前最準確的轉寫模型之一，準確度為 1.0 的兩倍，價格相同。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic says Claude now leads 26% of its model R&D tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic：Claude 已主導 26% 模型研發任務
items_flat.summary_en: AP reported Anthropic said Claude is leading 26% of the company’s model research and development, completing most of a given task end-to-end from a high-level prompt under human supervision, and collaborating on about 90% of R&D. The share Claude “leads” was none in February and reached a quarter by August, with about 30,000 internal agents as of August.
items_flat.summary_zh: 美聯社報導，Anthropic 表示 Claude 已主導公司 26% 的模型研發，能在人類監督下從高層提示端到端完成多數任務，並參與約 90% 研發。2 月主導比例為零，8 月達四分之一，當時內部約有 3 萬個代理。
items_flat.analysis_en: If the 26% figure holds, internal automation is already a production fact, not a demo. That raises a measurement problem the lab itself has been pushing: outsiders still cannot see how “leads a task” is scored.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若 26% 成立，內部自動化已是產線事實而非演示。這正好凸顯實驗室自己在推的測量問題：外人仍看不到「主導任務」如何計分。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Codex 0.155.1 changes TUI reasoning-summary default
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI Codex 0.155.1 調整 TUI 推理摘要預設
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI shipped Codex 0.155.1, which disables reasoning summaries by default in new local TUI sessions so providers that reject those requests no longer fail the session. Explicit reasoning-summary settings are still honored.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Codex 0.155.1，新本地 TUI 工作階段預設關閉推理摘要，避免不支援該請求的供應商直接導致工作階段失敗；明確設定的推理摘要仍會生效。
items_flat.analysis_en: A compatibility patch, not a model launch. It shows how fast the Codex agent surface is moving—and how provider differences still break local sessions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是相容性修補，不是模型發布。顯示 Codex 代理介面迭代很快，供應商差異仍會打斷本地工作階段。

frontier_other.analysis_en: The story is the plugin marketplace layer, not a model jailbreak. Pinning was the control enterprises trusted; until Copilot is patched and remaining Gemini CLI installs are retired, the blast radius stays agent-wide.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 重點在外掛市集層，不是模型越獄。企業信任的控制是 pinning；在 Copilot 修補、Gemini CLI 舊安裝清退前，影響面仍是整條代理鏈。

frontier_other.title_en: The Verge profiles METR, Redwood, and Apollo as labs’ default independent auditors
frontier_other.title_zh: The Verge 專文：METR、Redwood、Apollo 成為實驗室默認獨立審計方
frontier_other.summary_en: The Verge published a reported profile of METR, Redwood Research, and Apollo Research, arguing recent OpenAI and Anthropic misalignment incidents have pushed the three nonprofits into the role of go-to independent auditors.
frontier_other.summary_zh: The Verge 刊出 METR、Redwood Research、Apollo Research 報導專文，認為近期 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的未對齊事件，已把這三家非營利組織推成前線實驗室的默認獨立審計方。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The auditors are now part of the product story, not a side beat. What remains unsettled is whether “embedded” access will be standardized—or stay a negotiated, lab-by-lab privilege.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 審計方已進入產品敘事，不再是邊角新聞。尚未確定的是「嵌入式」權限會否標準化，或仍是逐家談判的特權。

brief_en: Paid subscribers sued Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google, claiming public “pace the frontier” endorsements after Amodei’s Sept 12 essay were an illegal slowdown pact. Labs otherwise shipped no new flagship models in the last 12 hours; the day’s picture is safety-auditor embedding, a plugin RCE, Codex/TUI patches, and Reuters IPO-timing pressure.
brief_zh: 訂戶控告 Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceXAI 與 Google，指 Amodei 9/12 呼籲「放慢前線」後的公開附和構成違法協議。近 12 小時無旗艦新模型；全日主軸是嵌入式安全審計、外掛 RCE、Codex 修補與 IPO 前競爭壓力。
